neighbours.label: The first piece of a split identifier that is about to spell INVENTORY (or, weaker, PLAYLIST): e.g. '_IN' or '.IN' before 'VENTORY' in upper-case code constants; the output promotes the continuation 'vent' and suppresses the whole words ' inventory'/' playlist'

notes: Card: peaks on the first piece of Russian 'assortiment'/'inventar', Korean 'playlist', '_IN'(I), '.PL'(AYLISTS); output promotes 'vent', suppresses ' inventory', ' playlist', ' catalog'. Probes: 'self.MAX_INVENTORY' 0.82, 'player.MAX_INVENTORY_SIZE' 0.78, 'DEFAULT_PLAYLIST' 0.30, '.PLAYLISTS' 0.29; the single-token words ' inventory'/' playlist' in prose 0.18-0.27, a MAX_CAPACITY control 0.32 (so code near misses may leak).
